name: Worldspine Wurm
oracle_text:
Trample
When this creature dies, create three 5/5 green Wurm creature tokens with trample.
When Worldspine Wurm is put into a graveyard from anywhere, shuffle it into its owner's library.
blocked_sentences: When this creature dies, create three 5/5 green Wurm creature tokens with trample.
When Worldspine Wurm is put into a graveyard from anywhere, shuffle it into its owner's library.

needs.what: a 5/5 green Wurm creature token with trample
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `token_ids` has no Wurm token at all; the only 5/5 tokens are dragon_5_5_r_flying and elemental_5_5_rg, which differ in color, creature type and keyword. The `dies` trigger and `create_token` with `amount: {"const": 3}` are otherwise ready.

needs.what: a self trigger that fires when this card is put into a graveyard from ANY zone (battlefield, hand via discard, library via mill/surveil, stack via counter), so the triggered ability works from the graveyard and can shuffle the card (bound as the trigger subject) into its owner's library -- the Eldrazi titan clause shared by Emrakul, Ulamog and Kozilek
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `trigger_events` has `dies` and `leaves_battlefield` (with `to_zones`), which only see the battlefield and miss discard, mill and a countered spell -- the cases the clause exists for. `discard` covers only the hand. No event observes a card arriving in a graveyard from the library or stack, and no `card_level_rider_keys` entry (`tucks_itself` is a resolving spell's own fate) replaces it. Writing only the `dies` half would make a different card that stays in the graveyard when milled or discarded.
